title: CookWing: AI Recipe Chef - Apps on Google Play
excerpt: AI recipes grounded in real cooking references for more reliable quantities.
content_html:
Ever followed an AI-generated recipe exactly, only to wonder halfway through why it called for 800 g of cheese for four people?

CookWing was built to solve that problem.

AI is great at creating ideas, substitutions, and variations, but it can also make up proportions that simply don’t work. Before Wing builds your recipe, it looks for a real reference recipe from the dish’s culinary tradition and uses it to anchor the ingredient quantities.

Ask for lasagna? The quantities are grounded in an Italian reference recipe. Japanese curry? Japanese references. Korean jjigae, French gratin, Thai curry; the same principle applies.

Wing can still adapt everything to your serving size, available ingredients, allergies, preferences, and cooking style. It just doesn’t invent every quantity from scratch.

The flexibility of an AI chef, grounded in real cooking.

AI FLEXIBILITY, GROUNDED QUANTITIES

• Each generated recipe starts from a real culinary reference.

• Ingredient proportions are anchored before the recipe is personalized.

• Change the servings, ingredients, or dietary requirements while keeping a reliable culinary foundation.

CUSTOM AI RECIPES IN SECONDS

• Describe what you’re craving, the ingredients you have, or what’s left in your fridge. Wing creates a personalized recipe with an image, timings, quantities, and clear instructions.

• Choose the number of servings and your preferred style: quick for busy weeknights, traditional, or restaurant-worthy for a special dinner.

• Add your allergies, food preferences, and pantry staples once. CookWing remembers them for future recipes.

GUIDED COOKING AND BUILT-IN TIMERS

• Follow one clear instruction at a time in a step-by-step cooking mode designed for flour-covered hands.

• Start each step’s timer with a tap. Get an alert right on time, even when your phone is locked.

• Need to change course? Ask Wing while you cook: swap an ingredient, save a sauce, or adjust the cooking time.

MAKE EVERY RECIPE YOUR OWN

• Scale the number of servings in a tap and every ingredient quantity updates automatically.

• Adapt any recipe to make it vegetarian, gluten-free, dairy-free, quicker, or lighter.

IMPORT RECIPES FROM YOUTUBE AND TIKTOK

• Paste a link to a YouTube video or Short, or a TikTok video. CookWing turns it into a complete recipe with ingredients and step-by-step instructions, ready to cook.

GROCERY LIST AND PERSONAL COOKBOOK

• Add recipe ingredients to your grocery list in one tap.

• Save your favorites, find meals you’ve already cooked, and add photos of your finished dishes.

FRESH INSPIRATION EVERY DAY

• Explore new meal ideas in photos every day, from easy weeknight dinners and desserts to dishes from around the world.

Whether you need a quick dinner idea, an easy recipe for beginners, a meal for friends, or a chef-level challenge, CookWing gives you the creativity of AI with quantities grounded in real recipes.

AI recipes grounded in real cooking references for more reliable quantities.
